name: Commanding keeper
engine: Their keeper dominates his box: high crosses, headers and placed shots are harder; hard shots and low balls are not.
about: An opponent build. Their keeper dominates his box: +2 to them against your high crosses and headers, +1 against your placed shots. Hard shots, low crosses and passes across the goal are untouched. It taxes The keeper's guessing game (the placed shot is its payoff).
